option_relations.rationale: Metabolic encephalopathy is a broad term for brain dysfunction due to metabolic derangements, but it is not directly related to Vascular Parkinsonism.
Uremic encephalopathy is a specific type of metabolic encephalopathy due to kidney failure, but it is not directly related to Vascular Parkinsonism.
Extrapyramidal syndromes of chronic kidney disease and dialysis (EPS-CKDD) describes a group of movement disorders in CKD patients, but it is not directly related to Vascular Parkinsonism.
Metabolic Parkinsonism refers to parkinsonian symptoms caused by metabolic disorders, but it is not directly related to Vascular Parkinsonism.
